scoring.variant: the variant question sets the player's 'relation' to the Sabbat (fanatic, expression, family, resource, enemy); each character card maps the relation to a variant. Its answers can also add character points

questions.text: At 35,000 feet a passenger sees your fangs and opens his mouth to scream. What do you do?

answers.text: Punch him through the floor. And the hold. And the ocean.
Shoot him through the headrest. Silencer, obviously. The cabin pressure isn't.
Whisper in his ear. By landing he's signed me his kidneys, gratefully.
What fangs? I was never here.
Redesign his face without a mouth. He makes a lovely neck pillow.
Sing him the truth until the cabin decides we're both drunk.
Apologise. Eat him. Apologise with my mouth full.
'Asseyez-vous. Oubliez.' He sits. He forgets.

questions.text: Pitch me your perfect evening at the gaming table.

answers.text: A heist where I'm lying to all of you, and you find out too late.
A bar fight that turns into a debate about Carthage, then back into a bar fight.
An art film. I direct, you bleed, and the lighting is gorgeous.
A fever dream where only I can hear the prophecy.
A nature documentary, and I'm the part they cut for being too upsetting.
A sad comedy about a loser who refuses to lose.
A slow reveal. Everyone thinks I'm harmless until the blanket comes off.
My animals do the dirty work: rats in the vents, a three-legged cat on watch.
'Ever danced with the Devil in the pale moonlight?' Then I introduce them.
I dissolve him from the inside, then drink him through a straw.
Socratic debate, three hours, until he admits he doesn't exist.
They get tired of beating me up.
I hide. You've walked past me four times tonight.
I dim the cabin lights. When they come back on, his seat is empty and his tray table is in the upright position.

questions.text: What kink do you bring to a party?

answers.text: Supernatural boobs. Supernatural ass. Supernatural EV-RY-THING!
Fifty centimetres of pure hardness, and the camera's already rolling.
Limbs. Limbs. Lots and lots of limbsssss.
Experience. A few centuries of it. You won't be the first king I've had on his knees.
Fifty centimetres of forked tongue… and I know how to use it.
A cute extra hole in my head, courtesy of a spade.
A lab coat and forty trained rats. You'll never guess where they go.
Hit me. Harder. You will get tired long before I do.
Greek wrestling. Oiled, naked.
Roleplay. I'll be anyone you want. Literally anyone.

questions.text: What is the Sabbat to you?

answers.text: The Sword of Caine. The Archbishop knows my name, and I know my orders.
A stage with no curtain. It lets me be exactly what I am.
My family. Nobody touches my pack.
A tool. I use it until it breaks.
The enemy. I'm inside it, and I'm taking it apart.
